title: BigCommerce merchants impacted by third-party app data breach
summary: The breach occurred between September 13 and September 17, 2026, when attackers gained access to shopper data via compromised credentials for the Ribon and Ribon 1.5 applications.
why_it_matters: Exploit-ready vulnerabilities can rapidly translate into compromise—especially for internet-facing services and widely deployed products.
